summary: Absci Corp filed an 8-K with Items 2.02 and 8.01 to furnish its Q1 2026 earnings press release and an investor presentation. The press release details business updates, financial results, and pipeline progress, including dosing updates for ABS-201 and the addition of ABS-202. There is no M&A, activist, restructuring, or other special situation event. The filing is a routine disclosure of operating results and corporate updates.
